business.about: Titan Company Ltd is among India’s most respected lifestyle companies. It has established leadership positions in the Watches, Jewellery and Eyewear categories led by its trusted brands and differentiated customer experience. It was founded in 1984 as a joint-venture between TATA Group and Tamilnadu Industrial Development Corporation (TIDCO). [1]

results.read: Revenue +10% YoY; EBITDA margin expanded 446 bps YoY to 14% — the highest in 9 quarters; PAT +114% — profits outran sales.

calls: Weak cash conversion: 5-yr operating cash flow is 0.43× reported profit

items.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
items.quote: I think we still, Mihir, would like to anchor our margin target at around 11%.

items.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
items.quote: One thing I will add to Arun's point, and while some of you suggest us that should we relook at our margin guidance, and we keep saying that, no, we want to keep it anchored around 11%, two, three things.

items.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
items.quote: Given all those environment, we are saying that it looks like that we can confidently deliver margin which is anchored around 11%, and we don't want in a hurry to either change that.

items.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
items.quote: While these gains will be realized as the inventory gets sold over the next couple of quarters, but in this quarter, we had overall at a consolidated level realization of ₹407 crores, ₹386 crores was in Tanishq Mia Zoya portfolio and ₹21 crores was in CaratLane.

items.speaker: Percy Panthaki
items.quote: And I'm not talking only about Q4, although the anniversarization happens in Q4, this is more of a general or a structural kind of a query that if for a few quarters, the Y-o-Y gold price inflation is zero in that scenario, does our growth rate come down versus our targeted 18% to 20% band?

items.speaker: Percy Panthaki
items.quote: And in context of that, do you expect sort of the headwind on your margins to sort of maybe turn into a tailwind and you could see even with a slightly lower growth being able to deliver that 18% to 20% bottom line growth?

items.speaker: Ajoy Chawla
items.quote: If I may add, if you're looking for what is that we are targeting, we are targeting, as always, a double-digit aggressive growth, and that's something which we shared even in the Investor Day.

items.speaker: Ajoy Chawla
items.quote: So for us to target a healthy double-digit growth in jewellery is inevitable.

items.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
items.quote: So their normal trajectory should be towards 10%.

items.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
items.quote: So, this guidance of 15%-20%, you look more that we have the way we are running business, the way Indian macros are behaving, we believe 15% to 20%, three to five-year kind of horizon is certainly to be delivered on a CAGR basis kind of a thing.

items.speaker: Percy Panthaki
items.quote: So, when you are saying a 15%-20% growth, aren't you lowballing the possible growth for FY27 given where the gold price is currently?

items.speaker: Arun Narayan
items.quote: Our sense is that perhaps we have gained about 50 to 60 bps is our sense on FY26 versus FY25.

items.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
items.quote: So I expect that overall margin, we had -- if you remember, a couple of quarters back, we had said that, gradually, CaratLane with the scale will start inching towards double-digit EBIT margin.

items.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
items.quote: And I think they have reached -- they are maybe slightly earlier than what we expected, but I think they would stay there, low double-digit margin EBIT profile.

items.speaker: N. S. Raghavan
items.quote: So as far as our growth outlook is concerned, we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.

items.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
items.quote: And on a long term, I would say the kind of investments are required, mid-teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.

items.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia
items.quote: As far as jewellery is concerned, yes, we did speak about 50 basis points last time onetime, which was expected to reverse over the next 2 quarters.
